description: A total levy or payment for the support of a government that is required of persons, groups, or businesses within the domain of that government.

appliedTaxTypeCode.description: The code specifying the applied tax type such as VAT.

basisAmount.description: The monetary value used as the basis in calculating the applied tax.

calculatedAmount.description: The monetary value resulting from the calculation of the applied tax.

calculatedRate.description: The rate used to calculate the applied tax.

taxPointDate.description: The date of the tax point when taxes, such as VAT, are to be applied.
